entities.summary: Cody Ford is an American professional football offensive tackle for the Cincinnati Bengals of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oklahoma Sooners. He has played in the NFL for the Buffalo Bills, Arizona Cardinals and Cincinnati Bengals.
